notes:
I couldn't write the Micah 1 notes. My research tools stopped working before I could read any of the pages.

My first attempt to fetch the commentary pages failed because of an error in my own code, before any page loaded. When I tried again, the tool refused because I'd used up my allowed calls for this turn. So I haven't read anything from Enduring Word, Bible Hub, StudyLight, Precept Austin, NET Bible or any other approved site. Your rules say to report only what the pages say and to cite a URL for every point. I'd have to write from memory, so I've written nothing.

If you send another message (even just "continue"), I'll start again and read these pages first:

- **Enduring Word (David Guzik):** https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/micah-1/
- **Precept Austin:** https://www.preceptaustin.org/micah-1-commentary
- **Bible Hub, older commentaries:**
  - Gill: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/micah/1.htm
  - Ellicott: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/micah/1.htm
  - Pulpit Commentary: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/micah/1.htm
- **StudyLight, John Wesley's notes (Methodist):** https://www.studylight.org/commentaries/eng/wen/micah-1.html
- **NET Bible notes (modern scholarship):** https://netbible.org/bible/Micah+1

After that I'd look for:
- Catholic and Orthodox readings on newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org.
- Places where Protestant traditions differ. Verses 3–4 (God coming down) and 7 (the prostitute's wages) seem the most likely, along with the wordplay on town names in vv. 10–16.
- Any well-known popular modern teaching on the chapter.

Then I'll write the notes verse by verse, each point with its URL, and leave out anything I can't find.
